mechanism: Oxacillin can cause interstitial nephritis leading to acute kidney injury, which impairs furosemide clearance and increases diuretic toxicity risk; furosemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may be exacerbated.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and sodium), and fluid status closely during concurrent use; adjust furosemide dose based on renal function changes.
